You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From 78bef577bcc3f4dc003202f8496100a75535527c Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: magnum <john.magnum@hushmail.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Apr 2013 23:26:50 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] raw-SHA512-ng, fix a bug introduced in 14a5985

---
 src/rawSHA512_ng_fmt.c | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/src/rawSHA512_ng_fmt.c b/src/rawSHA512_ng_fmt.c
index 4ca57bf2e..b5700485f 100644
--- a/src/rawSHA512_ng_fmt.c
+++ b/src/rawSHA512_ng_fmt.c
@@ -304,7 +304,7 @@ static void set_key (char *key, int index)
         buf8[len++] = *key++;
     buf64[15] = len << 3;
     buf8[len++] = 0x80;
-    while (buf8[len] && len < MAXLEN)
+    while (buf8[len] && len <= MAXLEN)
         buf8[len++] = 0;
 }
 
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by an off-by-one error in the while loop condition that sets padding bytes in the SHA-512 input buffer. The original condition `len < MAXLEN` was incorrect and failed to include the last position in the buffer, which could lead to buffer overflow or incorrect padding if the length of the key was exactly MAXLEN. Changing the condition to `len <= MAXLEN` correctly handles the padding and ensures that the buffer is filled properly without overflowing.

Root cause:
The bug was caused by an off-by-one error in the while loop condition that sets padding bytes in the SHA-512 input buffer. The original condition `len < MAXLEN` was incorrect and failed to include the last position in the buffer, which could lead to buffer overflow or incorrect padding if the length of the key was exactly MAXLEN. Changing the condition to `len <= MAXLEN` correctly handles the padding and ensures that the buffer is filled properly without overflowing.
